headline: Corn and sugarcane make up 65% of the value of the five main crops, while coffee tripled in five years (25% CAGR)
insights: **Coffee leapt:** from R$ 38 bi to R$ 115 bi, the fastest growth of the five
**Wheat lags:** R$ 10 bi in 2024, barely above 2019
**Concentration:** corn and sugarcane are R$ 284 bi of R$ 434 bi in 2024
takeaway: Prioritize corn, sugarcane and coffee: they combine scale with demonstrated growth.
